segments.title: 第106章 溪溪歸我了
segments.content:
Chapter 106: Xixi is Mine Now

On the way home, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi sat in the back row, while Ying Zhicheng was in the front passenger seat, letting the wind blow in through the open window.

Without asking how the two felt about their midterm exams, Ying Zhicheng simply made casual inquiries about trivial matters at school.

How were the teachers, were the clubs fun, was the cafeteria food any good.

And, whether they were used to living at Bi Hai Lan Ting.

"I've heard some news," Ying Zhicheng said. "The subway plan for Yinjiang District will most likely be announced by the end of this year, or after the Lunar New Year."

"I was thinking I could buy a property along the line. On one hand, it can be an investment; on the other, I can leave it to you in the future."

As he spoke, Ying Zhicheng looked at Ying Chanxi. "Would you prefer a place near Affiliated High No. 1 and Qianjiang University, or somewhere closer to the South Station?"

The meaning behind his words was quite simple.

He was asking if Ying Chanxi wanted to move out of Bi Hai Lan Ting.

However, it was clear that Ying Chanxi had no such thoughts. She just shook her head and said, "Dad, you can decide for yourself. I don't know anything about this stuff."

After that, Ying Chanxi took the parent-teacher conference notice from her schoolbag and handed it to Ying Zhicheng in the passenger seat. "There's a parent-teacher conference next Saturday. See if you're busy with work at the company."

"Next Saturday?" Ying Zhicheng frowned, carefully reading the contents of the notice. "Xiao Lu, what's my schedule for next Saturday?"

The driver at his side immediately responded to Ying Zhicheng's question, "President Ying, you have a two-day business trip to Changning City starting next Friday. You won't be back until Sunday."

"Oh, right, the matter of the film and television rights." Ying Zhicheng tapped his forehead, feeling a bit of a headache.

After hearing this from the back row, Ying Chanxi shook her head nonchalantly. "It's alright, Dad. If you have work, you should go. Just let the teacher know in advance."

"I suppose that's the only way," Ying Zhicheng said helplessly.

Returning to Jincheng Residential Community, the three of them went up to the fourth floor.

Ying Chanxi and Ying Zhicheng first put their things away at home, then went to Room 401.

Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were still busy in the kitchen. Hearing the noise at the door, Li Guohong poked his head out and called, "Have a seat on the sofa for a bit, the food's almost ready."

"I brought you a bottle of good liquor," Ying Zhicheng said with a smile, carrying a bottle of baijiu and placing it on the dining table.

Seeing the liquor in her dad's hand, Ying Chanxi furrowed her brows in displeasure and muttered under her breath, "Drinking again."

"They've always been like this." Li Luo glanced at Ying Chanxi. "You're still not used to it?"

"I can't control my dad and Uncle." Ying Chanxi stared at Li Luo and warned, "You're not allowed to drink in the future."

"You can't control them, but you think you can control me?"

"Hmph, if you dare drink secretly, I'll tell Auntie Lin."

"Childish. That's the only trick you know."

A short while later, the dishes were all served.

After the five of them were seated at the table, Li Guohong and Ying Zhicheng began to exchange toasts. Lin Xiuhong then looked at Li Luo and asked impatiently, "How did you do on your exams?"

"Definitely better than last time, at least," Li Luo said conservatively. "I should have a shot at the top one hundred."

"Oh?" Ying Zhicheng was a little surprised to hear this. "The top one hundred including the key classes?"

"That's right." Li Luo nodded calmly.

"For real?" Lin Xiuhong was a bit skeptical. "You were 86th in the entire district for the high school entrance exam. If you count the 160 students from the early independent admissions, you were actually ranked in the two hundreds, right?"

"Mom, I suggest you don't underestimate your son too much," Li Luo kindly advised. "As they say, one should be seen in a new light after being apart for only three days. Why would I lie to you about something like this?"

"Li Luo is very smart," Ying Chanxi added from the side. "Sister Youyu and I were tutoring him continuously before the exams. He's made a lot of progress."

"Oh, no wonder." Lin Xiuhong nodded in understanding. "You had someone tutoring you. I forgot about that."

Li Luo was speechless.

So you'll believe anything Ying Chanxi says, huh?

"This Sister Youyu you mentioned, is she the girl you're renting with?" Ying Zhicheng asked curiously.

"Yes," Ying Chanxi nodded. "Her name is Xu Youyu. She's a second-year and the student council president, and she's first in the second-year cohort."

"Whoa! Xu Youyu is that amazing too?" Lin Xiuhong was a little surprised. She then looked at Li Luo. "No wonder you're so confident. With two cohort first-placers tutoring you, it would be utterly shameful if you didn't improve."

Li Luo was at a loss for words and couldn't be bothered to say more. In any case, when the results were announced at the parent-teacher conference next Saturday, everything would be revealed.

So Li Luo pulled the parent-teacher conference notice out of his schoolbag and handed it to his mom. "Parent-teacher conference is next Saturday. You should come. I'll let you enjoy some praise from my homeroom teacher."

"Alright." Lin Xiuhong nodded and took the notice naturally.

Li Guohong, at the side, glanced over, looking tempted. But knowing he couldn't win against his wife, his lips moved, but he didn't say a word.

He really wanted to go. After all, his son had rarely been so promising. He definitely wanted to attend a parent-teacher conference at Affiliated High No. 1.

But Lin Xiuhong was the first priority in the family, so Li Guohong had no choice but to give way.

After talking about the midterm exams, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong didn't ask much else.

As for the matter of Li Luo's writing, because they had previously agreed not to disclose the situation, they didn't bring it up with Ying Zhicheng and Ying Chanxi present.

The topic of conversation at the dinner table quickly shifted from the school's midterms and parent-teacher conference to finance, the stock market, policies, international affairs, and so on.

Finally, it settled on the recent policy changes in Yuhang City and the construction of the subway in Yinjiang District.

After hearing the news about the subway plan from Ying Zhicheng, both Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong beamed with delight.

Looking back, it seemed that their decision to reject Wei Dongrong's real estate investment and choose to buy the property at Bi Hai Lan Ting instead was truly a wise one.

Especially now that Li Luo could earn a considerable amount from his writing, the family's mortgage pressure had vanished in an instant, making the couple even more overjoyed.

Plus, Li Luo was now a student at Affiliated High No. 1. With a little hard work, he might even get into Qianjiang University.

Only a few months had passed, but when Li Guohong and his wife looked back, they suddenly realized that their family's situation seemed to have improved all at once.

The future was simply a field of shining stars.

And it all probably started with Li Luo's exceptional performance on the high school entrance exam.

"It's a bit of a shame though. I can't go to Xixi's parent-teacher conference this time. I have a business trip on Saturday." Having had a lot to drink, Ying Zhicheng started to talk more, patting Li Guohong on the shoulder with one hand. "Why don't you go in my place? You two basically treat Xixi as half a daughter. It's not too much to ask you to attend the parent-teacher conference for me, right?"

Hearing this, Li Guohong was first stunned, then he started to laugh. "Sure, are you certain? If you say so, I'm going to take it seriously."

"Why not?" Ying Zhicheng took another swig of liquor. "Just say you're Xixi's uncle."

"I don't think so," Lin Xiuhong chimed in from the side, shaking her head.

"Why not?" Li Guohong was instantly displeased. "You can go to Li Luo's parent-teacher conference, but I can't go to Xixi's?"

"What I mean is," Lin Xiuhong said with a grin, "I'll go to Xixi's parent-teacher conference, and you go to Li Luo's."

"On what grounds?!" Li Guohong's eyes widened in discontent. "How can Li Luo's parent-teacher conference be better than Xixi's?"

"You want to fight me for it?" Lin Xiuhong narrowed her eyes at him. "Xixi is mine now."

Although Li Guohong had drunk a lot, he wasn't drunk yet. Being stared at by Lin Xiuhong's narrowed eyes, he instantly fell silent, ultimately only managing to mutter, "So unreasonable."

"You guys are being ridiculous," Li Luo said with a speechless expression. "Who attends a parent-teacher conference for another family's kid?"

As soon as he said that, his foot was stomped on, hard.

He looked at Ying Chanxi beside him in astonishment, and then heard her say in a soft, delicate voice, "It would be wonderful if Uncle and Auntie could attend the parent-teacher conference for my dad."

(End of Chapter)
